as_told.title: Lue Elizondo as a Grey Fox alumnus

plain: A former Pentagon intelligence official named Luis Elizondo is said to have been part of the Intelligence Support Activity, also called Gray Fox, a secretive military unit that scouts very sensitive areas ahead of the elite forces of Joint Special Operations Command, the command over America's top special operations units. Michels tells this twice: once crediting an online researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb, who ties it to a hidden "legacy program" said to hold recovered craft, and once stating plainly himself that Elizondo is "an alumni of Greyfox", without crediting anyone or mentioning that program. The point is that the man who became a public face of UFO disclosure may come from the most secretive corner of the military.
